english.note: Use this for a shirt worn next to the skin to absorb sweat, rather than for an outer pullover.

examples.english: When I play ball, I wear a sweatshirt over my undershirt.
examples.traditional: 我打波嗰陣，會喺汗衫出面着件衛衣。
